messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning dashboards for per-model/route latency + throughput SLOs. Need agreement on metric names, tag cardinality, and rollup policy. cc @rahul @devin

rahul: Can we reuse the existing redwood metrics? Need P50/P95/P99, TTFT, and tokens/sec surfaced per route+model.

devin: We already emit a Prom histo `redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket` and a `redwood_request_tokens_total` counter. Problem: current label set includes customer_id which is causing cardinality blowups when combined with route+model+zone.

maya: Right — for the console default panels we should avoid customer_id to keep costs down. We still need it for dedicated views (enterprise) but not for the global per-route SLOs.

sophia: Telemetry question: ingest needs sample rates + retention. If we keep full cardinality for 90d cost balloons. Proposal: keep raw 10s resolution for 7d, 1m rollups for 90d. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

ellie: Agree on rollups. Also we should standardize metric names for dashboard templates. Proposed canonical names: `redwood.request.duration_seconds_bucket`, `redwood.request.ttft_ms`, `redwood.request.tokens_total`.

devin: PromQL examples for the console (draft):
```
# p95 latency for route+model over 5m window
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"$route", model=~"$model"}[5m])) by (le))

# TTFT (avg) over 5m
sum(rate(redwood_request_ttft_ms_sum{route=~"$route", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_request_ttft_ms_count{route=~"$route", model=~"$model"}[5m]))

# tokens/sec over 1m
sum(rate(redwood_request_tokens_total{route=~"$route", model=~"$model"}[1m]))
```

rahul: We'll need normalized `route` and `model` label values (no spaces, lowercase, max length). Also add an optional `model_variant` label for canary rollouts. That lets dashboards show variant split.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-4123 — "dashboard ingest + metric contract for per-route SLOs". Assigned: telemetry + infra. <https://jira.example.com/browse/INF-4123> :white_check_mark:

maya: Action items: 1) infra: add normalized `route`/`model` labels + `model_variant` (opt) 2) telemetry: implement rollup policy (10s raw for 7d, 1m for 90d) 3) devex: build dashboard templates + template variables 4) eng: propose alert thresholds for P99 and TTFT. I'll open a GH PR with the draft queries.

devin: I'll draft the GH PR with template panels. Quick question — preferred window for throughput metric: 1m or 5m?

sophia: Ops prefers 1m for tokens/sec (fast feedback), 5m for latency percentiles to avoid noise from small spikes.

ellie: Alert proposal to discuss: P99 > 800ms sustained for 5m => sev3. TTFT > 1500ms sustained 3m => page. Also add a sample-count guard (ignore percentiles if qps < X). :thumbsup:

rahul: Sounds reasonable. For low-volume models use `max_over_time(...)` or a min samples condition so percentiles aren't misleading. Also add `route` fallback mapping for legacy route names.

maya: Great. I'll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT and add the action items to INF-4123. Please comment on the GH PR when it's up. Thanks everyone! :pray:
